observations: Separate broad dark windshield gasket, two wipers and their lower pivots, layered grille slats, small upper Mercedes badge and larger grille star.
Two rectangular auxiliary blue lamps are mounted in front of the grille; roof blue beacons have protective metal hoops.
Glossy red cab paint reflects its surroundings, while tyres, rubber gaskets and grille remain rough.
visualCorrections.implementation: Preserve real silhouettes and material boundaries before adding small texture marks; do not infer the unseen dashboard from reflections.

observations: Grey moulded door panels, yellow vertical grab poles, black seat cushions, pale seat boxes and dark rubber floor.
Two metal step treads have round anti-slip embossing and narrow blue light strips at their front edge.
Warning triangles and blue/yellow line bags have separate brackets; fixed cradles stay with the door.
visualCorrections.implementation: Keep seams, bevelled edges and recessed handles in geometry; use flat woven straps and visible buckles, not cylinders resembling rope.

observations: Pump controls occupy two black panels with cream gauge faces, black rotary controls and small coloured pushbuttons.
Yellow and green handwheels, weathered aluminium pipes, dark rubber hoses and textured tread plate have visibly different finishes.
The upper foam-system panel is angled and framed; hoses above it are large dark cylinders.
visualCorrections.implementation: Do not invent gauge readings or unreadable control legends; model visible control spacing and layers.

observations: Storz coupling mouths show an inner dark gasket and opposing metal engagement lugs; rings are not featureless chrome tubes.
The yellow WEBER reel flange has actual open holes and a red second flange; hoses are black rubber with coiled connections.
Red retaining straps are broad woven ribbons with buckles. They are separate from the removable tool.
Paint wear is concentrated on exposed edges and contact points; aluminium cases have seams, handles, folded edges and fasteners.
visualCorrections.implementation: Add real holes, modest edge bevels and material-specific roughness. Any numerical shader roughness is an artistic calibration, not a measured property.
